name: OMI residential leases by municipality
publisher: Agenzia delle Entrate, Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (OMI)

measures.definition: Average rent per m² a month of homes let whole in new long-term open-market leases (ORD_L) registered in the year in the municipality (the year's total rent over the total floor area), times 50 m².
Average rent per m² a month of homes let whole in new long-term open-market leases (ORD_L) registered in the year in the municipality (the year's total rent over the total floor area), times 90 m².

rights.edition: Rapporto Immobiliare 2026, residential leases annex (2018-2025), published 21 May 2026

vetted.notes: Official: every residential lease registered with the Agenzia delle Entrate. The report's second page reads: the information may be used, also processed, provided that the source is cited when published; selling, renting, transferring or assigning the data is not allowed. Not a CC BY licence, so its figures sit in their own file. ORD_L is the open market for three years or more (canone libero in these cities, all of which are high housing-pressure municipalities); subsidised (canone concordato) and transitional leases are left out.

caveats: Rents declared on registration; a lease left unregistered is not counted.
Average over every home let, so a one- or three-bedroom rent is the rate per m² times a fixed size, not a figure for that size.
